programme.title: Kick-Ass
programme.desc: Using his love for comics as inspiration, teenager Dave Lizewski (Aaron Johnson) decides to reinvent himself as a superhero -- despite a complete lack of special powers. Dave dons a costume, dubs himself "Kick-Ass," and gets to work fighting crime. He joins forces with the father/daughter vigilante team of Big Daddy and Hit Girl, then befriends another fledgling crime-fighter called Red Mist (Christopher Mintz-Plasse), but a scheming mobster soon puts their alliance to the test.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: Within 24 hours of being released from a 10-year sentence, Frankie (Adrien Brody) threatens to drag his brother James (Hayden Christensen) back into the criminal underworld that nearly swallowed them both years before.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: For many years, Nathan Harper (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that life with his family isn't quite what it seems. His fears come true when he finds a picture of himself as a youngster on a missing-persons website, proof that the people he's called mom and dad his whole life are not his real parents. As he draws close to uncovering his true identity, Nathan becomes the target of assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen (Lily Collins), the only person he can now trust.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant

Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: A discredited former cop connects a murder case to an elaborate conspiracy involving high-stakes treason.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: A discredited former cop connects a murder case to an elaborate conspiracy involving high-stakes treason.

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: A crime lord plots to take control of New York's underground drug economy and distribute the profits to the poor.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the "Tooth Fairy" (Tom Noonan). Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer -- and cannibal -- Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecter and an interfering journalist (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: The Lieutenant (Harvey Keitel) is a corrupt cop steeped in gambling debt who exploits his authority to sexually harass teenage girls, embezzle money and abuse drugs. His troubles come to a head when a mob lackey delivers an ultimatum: pay off his debt, or else. His fate appears sealed. But when The Lieutenant learns that a $50,000 reward is being offered to whoever catches a pair of thugs who raped a nun (Frankie Thorn), he jumps at the opportunity, hoping that he can still redeem himself.

programme.title: Light Sleeper
programme.desc: A Manhattan drug dealer with a wealthy clientele, John LeTour reevaluates both his trade and his life after discovering that his supplier, Ann, is planning on quitting the business. When John runs into his old flame Marianne, he sees reconnecting with her as a way to change for the better, but she is reluctant to rekindle the romance. Complicating John's life further is a series of drug-related murders that has the police pegging him as a suspect.

The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Long Time Dead
programme.desc: After a long night of dancing and drinking their way into a haze, roommates Rob (Joe Absolom), Liam (Alec Newman), Stella (Lara Belmont) and Spencer (James Hillier) and a few of their friends duck into a back room of the nightclub to play around with a Ouija board. None of the friends like what the board tells them: they will all die that night. Sure enough, one by one the young friends are slaughtered by a malevolent killer, amid revelations about satanic worship and sacrifice.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A guardian (David Knight) and his lover (Moira Redmond) stage grim scenes to drive a haunted English heiress (Jennie Linden) mad.

programme.title: Not Safe for Work
programme.desc: An office worker becomes trapped in a building with a killer.

programme.title: Phantasm II
programme.desc: Years after surviving his encounter with the sinister Tall Man (Angus Scrimm), Mike Pearson (James LeGros), now a mental patient, still has nightmares about the evil gaunt mortician. Upon being released from the institution, Mike and his friend Reggie (Reggie Bannister) set out to track down the Tall Man and end his murderous and macabre practices. Also involved is Liz Reynolds (Paula Irvine), a pretty young woman who has a psychic connection to both Mike and the Tall Man.

programme.title: Rosewood Lane
programme.desc: Sonny Blake (Rose McGowan), a radio talk show therapist, moves back to her childhood home after her father dies. She is shocked to learn her neighbors are terrified of the paperboy (Daniel Ross Owens) who turns out to be a dangerous sociopath.

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing, abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts, steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Spider Woman Strikes Back
programme.desc: She (Gale Sondergaard) and her hulking servant grow bloodsucking plants, as a young woman (Brenda Joyce) finds out.

programme.title: Stephanie
programme.desc: A young girl is left alone in her house during a worldwide catastrophe and fearfully hides from a malevolent force that is stalking her. When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

When the Druglord captures Prince, he soon finds himself in an epic battle to save the last remnants of humanity.

programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Los Humillados
programme.desc: Dos hermanos, uno compositor y el otro cantante, van a probar fama y fortuna a la capital.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.

programme.title: La hija sin padre
programme.desc: Una joven cantante se enamora de un hombre y se casa, pero este niega ser el padre de la criatura que ella espera.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El rey de los albures
programme.desc: Un vendedor de tacos famoso por sus chistes participa en un concurso de baile con su ahijada para poder pagar una deuda.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La hora del jaguar
programme.desc: Como agente de la policía se caracterizó por ser el más despiadado, ahora retirado, se convierte en asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Asesino del Metro
programme.desc: El miedo se impone sobre la Ciudad de México, cuando un asesino a sus víctimas, todas mujeres, en el metro de la ciudad.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper

Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

Benjamin Kasparian is a paleontologist of Armenian descent who has just split up with his wife Amanda. programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: Amazing guests, unheard stories and fresh cuts. Just another day at The Shop.This week, Maverick Carter and Paul Rivera chop it up with an exceptional group: Simu Liu, Tobe Nwigwe, Baron Davis and Calvin Johnson. Simu talks about his unique journey from being an accountant to starring in one of Marvel’s biggest films — establishing himself as a movie star. Tobe talks about his own experience in film, transitioning from football to music and his Nigerian upbringing. Baron breaks down being a multi-faceted creative, navigating his passions outside of basketball and his first-hand experience of “Linsanity.” Calvin discusses his legendary NFL career, his relationship with the Lions organization and the importance of having confidence instilled at a young age. The guys also dive into entrepreneurship, their personal businesses and much more.

programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: The crew is back! Paul Rivera and Maverick Carter sit with a star-studded group this week: Johnny Manziel, GloRilla, mgk, Hit-Boy and Alycia Baumgardner. Johnny and the guys analyze his legendary college career, the good and the bad, his growth over the years and reminisce on his past working relationship with Maverick. mgk talks about coming up in Cleveland, memories being more valuable than money and being in the rap game for respect. GloRilla talks about the come-up, her family’s early reactions to her music, money management and the importance of having a strong team. Hit-Boy discusses his relationship with his father Big Hit, from making music to making up for lost time, career production highlights and bad publishing deals. Alycia walks the group through her approach in the ring, integrity as an athlete and representation as a woman in boxing. You don’t want to miss this one.

programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: For episode 7, we got a very special group together. Andre 3000, LeBron James, Sexyy Red, Jerry Lorenzo, Jiaoying Summers, and Nigel Sylvester sit down with Maverick Carter and Paul Rivera for an unforgettable conversation. Andre discusses the early days of Outkast and the Dungeon Family, the legacy of Rico Wade, his love for the flute and a lot more. LeBron talked about aspiring to be something greater when growing up, his favorite Andre verses ever and having out-of-body experiences on the court. Sexyy breaks down how she first started rapping, how she deals with nerves before hitting the stage and the importance of timing. Jerry talks about the how his faith drives his creativity and decision-making, not wanting people to put a label on him and more. Jiaoying hilariously gives us insight into her comedy style, how she got her start and performing at The Apollo. Nigel talks coming up in Queens, New York, when he first found his love of bicycle riding and how he approaches brand-building.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon prepares the famous Fat Doug burger, a signature dish from his former restaurant B Spot Burgers that won the Sobey Burger Bash championship twice. The burger features crispy pastrami, melted Swiss cheese, and tangy coleslaw on a potato roll. Meanwhile, co-host Liz Symon creates an improvisational cherry cola cocktail made with Averna Amaro, Cointreau, amaretto cherries, and seltzer that unexpectedly tastes remarkably like classic Coke. The episode explores the burger's history, cooking technique over live fire, and the importance of quality ingredients and balanced flavors.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon take on the ultimate comfort food by each creating their own version of a grilled cheese sandwich, showcasing three distinct styles that range from classic to elevated. Michael leads with a rich and decadent Croque Madame, complete with a homemade mornay sauce, gruyère, ham, and a perfectly cooked egg on top, sharing tips on building flavor and texture through technique. Carla follows with a Southern-inspired twist, hollowing out a brioche bun to stuff it with pimento cheese and tangy chow chow pickles, emphasizing balance and texture in every bite. Clinton rounds things out with a fan-inspired take on a classic grilled cheese, combining American, cheddar, and gruyère cheeses on rye bread, using mayonnaise for an evenly crisp, golden exterior. Throughout the episode, the trio trades stories, jokes, and cooking insights, debating everything from sandwich ratios to restaurant culture. They later shift into a lively “overrated vs. underrated” game, diving into food trends, brunch culture, and even aging, blending humor with candid reflections. The episode wraps with a fan giveaway and appreciation for sponsors, leaving viewers inspired to experiment with their own grilled cheese creations at home.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon dive into an episode celebrating coffee and food pairing. The hosts prepare two standout recipes: a homemade Cinnamon Coffee Cake perfect for breakfast or dessert, and an authentic Buena Vista–Style Irish Coffee that brings San Francisco cafe tradition into home kitchens. Viewers get insider tips and techniques from three seasoned culinary professionals.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon demonstrates how to make Korean-style short ribs using a quick grilling method combined with a flavorful Asian pear-based marinade featuring soy, mirin, gojuchang, and sesame oil. The thin-cut ribs marinate for 6-12 hours to tenderize, then grill for just 3 minutes per side over high heat. Michael garnishes the finished ribs with crispy scallions, cilantro, a sesame-chili mix, and lime. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares a refreshing soju mojito by muddling fresh mint and lime, then adding soju, lime juice, and maple syrup for depth. Liv Annacone joins the hosts as they discuss the ease and flavor of both dishes.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon shares comprehensive garlic education on this Halloween-themed episode of Chewed Up, demonstrating proper peeling methods using a bowl-shaking technique, various cutting approaches including microplane mincing and hand-slicing, and the benefits of removing garlic germs to reduce bitterness. He advocates strongly for using whole fresh garlic rather than pre-peeled or jarred varieties, explaining how commercial processing compromises flavor. The episode culminates with preparation of luxurious Robuchon-style mashed potatoes—equal parts potatoes and butter—garnished with roasted garlic cloves, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh chives, and served alongside grilled garlic bread.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon takes over the kitchen to teach essential knife skills and prep techniques that can instantly improve anyone’s cooking game. Joined by Clinton Kelly and Carla Hall, the trio dives into the importance of sharp knives, proper sharpening methods, and why most home cooks only really need three knives in their kitchen arsenal. Michael demonstrates how to properly hold a chef’s knife, sharpen blades using a wheel sharpener, and explains the difference between honing and sharpening, while Clinton enthusiastically jumps in with detailed play-by-play commentary and cooking science facts. Carla keeps the conversation lively with jokes about Michael’s long-winded explanations and practical reminders about time-saving kitchen habits. Throughout the episode, Michael walks viewers through slicing celery, chiffonading herbs, and properly dicing onions while explaining the safest and most efficient cutting techniques. The hosts also passionately debate cutting boards, with Michael launching into a hilarious rant against plastic, ceramic, and glass boards in favor of traditional wood boards. Humor runs throughout the segment, including a conversation about Ginsu knives, microplastics, and Clinton’s grammar-school definition of “interjections.” The episode wraps with the “Fan of the Day” segment, where Lysa from Seattle wins a personalized video message from the hosts, followed by a final round of playful insults and banter before signing off.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Carla Hall shares her ultimate biscuit-making secrets while teaching two different techniques for creating perfect homemade biscuits. Joined by Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly, Carla walks through her trusted biscuit recipe while revealing the small adjustments and baking tricks she has collected over years of cooking, tasting, and learning from other biscuit makers. The conversation centers around how technique can completely transform the same recipe, as Carla demonstrates both drop biscuits baked in muffin tins and laminated layered biscuits made through folding and stacking dough. Along the way, the hosts discuss the importance of cold butter, the role of steam in creating flaky layers, and why full-fat buttermilk makes a major difference in texture and tenderness. Michael and Clinton enthusiastically jump into the science behind baking while keeping the conversation playful, debating butter pockets, crispy edges, and the superiority of muffin-tin stuffing. Carla also shares clever practical tricks, including using oil instead of excess flour on the work surface and flipping biscuit dough for better height and rise. The trio reflects on how cooking competition shows continue to teach even experienced chefs new techniques, reinforcing the episode’s theme that cooking is a constant learning process. After pulling both styles of biscuits from the oven, the hosts compare the textures and flavors of each version while slathering them with butter, jam, and honey. The episode wraps with Carol from Columbus, Ohio being selected as the “Fan of the Day,” earning a personalized message from the hosts before everyone signs off stuffed and satisfied.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon put eight different store-bought salsas to the ultimate taste test in a bracket-style showdown to determine which salsa deserves the top spot. The trio samples everything from chunky bean-and-corn varieties to smoky roasted garlic blends and fiery chipotle-forward options while debating what makes a great salsa, including texture, freshness, acidity, spice level, and chip compatibility. Along the way, the hosts joke about grammar corrections, “street cred,” and Michael’s love of spicy food while offering surprisingly detailed flavor breakdowns. Carla picks up floral notes in one salsa, Michael compares another to Fruity Pebbles cereal, and Clinton passionately defends smoother, sauce-like salsas that would work well on enchiladas. As the competition narrows, the hosts discover that their favorites lean toward bold, chef-driven flavor profiles featuring cumin, roasted garlic, and layered chile heat rather than basic restaurant-style salsa. Michael gravitates toward the spiciest contender while Clinton and Carla favor a cumin-forward salsa that feels homemade and versatile enough to cook with. The episode wraps with a cheerful “Fan of the Day” segment celebrating Lisa from Detroit before the hosts sign off.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Carla Hall, and Clinton Kelly take on one of the internet’s most overhyped dishes — avocado toast — and each put their own spin on the trendy classic. Michael keeps things fresh and herb-forward with mashed avocado, citrus, chili flakes, dill, mint, chives, and crunchy sea salt while sharing his philosophy on cooking intuitively and using whatever is in the fridge or garden. Clinton recreates a nostalgic avocado and grapefruit salad from the 1980s, layering honey-drizzled grapefruit, poppy seeds, and red onion over avocado toast for a sweet and savory twist. Carla keeps hers simple and flavorful with fresh herbs and crispy shallots. Along the way, the hosts debate food trends, influencer culture, protein obsession, anchovies, and the infamous “avocado hand” kitchen injury, leading to plenty of playful bickering and laughs between Clinton and Michael. The show wraps with the trio agreeing that there’s no single right way to make avocado toast — it’s all about personal taste and creativity in the kitchen.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Carla Hall, and Clinton Kelly welcome acclaimed Miami chef Michelle Bernstein to a special Miami Beach episode of Chewed Up filmed at the W Hotel in partnership with Experience Miami Beach. After sampling local bakery favorites including guava pastries and tequeños, the hosts celebrate Miami’s vibrant culinary scene and discuss Michelle’s lasting impact on South Florida food culture as she shares stories about her career, mentorship, and being honored during the South Beach Wine Food Festival’s 25th anniversary celebration. Michelle then teaches the group how to make her signature Cuban sandwich empanadas, transforming the classic Miami staple into a crispy handheld pastry filled with lechón, ham, cheese, pickles, and yellow mustard. As they assemble and fry their empanadas, the conversation ranges from Cuban sandwich authenticity and Latin food traditions to family roots and restaurant life. The group also plays a lively round of “Chew It or Screw It,” debating topics such as late dinner reservations, over-tipping, flip-flops at fine dining restaurants, poolside rosé, and afternoon Cuban coffee. During Fan Mail, they answer viewer questions about cooking with candied jalapeños, discuss which decade they would most like to have grown up in, and share their favorite ways to unwind after a long day. The episode wraps with the hosts tasting Michelle’s empanadas, praising the crisp dough and balanced flavors, while Michelle shares details about her new restaurant, La Cañita. Two audience giveaways are awarded before the hosts encourage viewers to experience everything Miami Beach has to offer.

He also answers an Ask Dave about his "broke chef" days.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "David Chang's Black Friday Leftover Sandwich v2.0!" - Dave does another version of his work-in-progress leftover sandwich that he's been working on to present to the MVP of the Black Friday Jets vs Dolphins game.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Dave Arnold's Mom's Stuffing (your new go-to holiday recipe)" - We're excited to share this insane, soon-to-be-family-standard recipe from our good friend, Dave Arnold, who is admittedly is still trying to figure this out from his own mom's recipe. This is THE. ACTUAL. DAVE. ARNOLD. filming himself making the aforementioned famous stuffing with some of our flourishes of text and music. I mean...this is it. Nobody, including Dave Arnold, knows how long to cook it or at what temperature you should cook it at, but we're confident if you're still reading this, you're going to do just fine.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "A THANKSGIVING MIRACLE! David Chang and Friends Make a FULL Thanksgiving Dinner in 2 hours?!?!" - David Chang is joined by Chris Ying and Chris Bianco while they attempt to make an entire Thanksgiving dinner in less than 2 hours...no cuts, no tricks. Just people cooking, cussin', starting things on fire, and having a (mostly) nice time. Hey, it's the holidays...we're all miserable.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "A Truly Incredible Sweet Potato Pie from Malcolm Livingston II" - Acclaimed pastry chef Malcolm Livingston II shares an absolutely INSANE recipe for sweet potato pie that will blow up everything you thought you know about sweet potato pie. You want those sharp edges that could poke an eye out? Of course you do. And the density! Malcolm describes it "like fudge"...or "a perfect caramel that leaves the teethmarks when you bite through it." It's honestly amazing and you don't even have to take our word for it, you can just make it for yourself. Don't be that person that brings some soggy, sloppy pie to your holiday party...watch this video and take notes!

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "David Chang Makes an Epic Thanksgiving Leftover Sandwich" - Dave has joined forces with Amazon Prime Thursday Night Football to create a new tradition for their first-ever Black Friday Football game on November 24—make a ridiculous sandwich for the game MVP using Thanksgiving leftovers. This is Dave's first attempt, so there are plenty of learnings discovered along the way as he tries to construct a worthy sandwich...making an entire Thanksgiving spread along the way. Get ready to unhinge your jaw, because this sandwich is something straight out of Shaggy and Scoob's playbook.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Lisa Donovan's Legendary Pie Crust" - There are pie-makers, and then there's world-renowned pastry chef Lisa Donovan. Lisa blesses the MajordomoTV Studio by taking us step-by-step through her zen-like process of making a perfect, flaky, tender, Southern-style pie crust. The technique! The poetry! The jokes about oversized rolling pins! Lisa is a true master of the pie arts, and if you've ever had ambitions to make your own crust—or just like to zone out watching hands sifting through butter and flour—there's no better place to start than a lesson from Ms. Donovan.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "David Chang recreates his mom's holiday specialty (bindaetteok 빈대떡)" - David Chang recreates his mom's holiday specialty (bindaetteok 빈대떡) - When Dave Chang was growing up, his mom always made mung-bean pancakes with kimchi, scallion, and pork belly for any celebratory dinner. So, as Dave gears up for the holidays, he's trying to channel her culinary energy into his own version of Korean bindaetteok. Try as he might, he just can't get it to taste exactly the same, but isn't that what makes moms special?

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Chicken Pot Pie from scratch in 45 minutes?! REAL-TIME COOKING" - After a long day of filming in the studio kitchen, Dave Chang wanted one more challenge. For no reason other than to see if he could do it, he attempted the utterly ridiculous task of making chicken pot pie, completely from scratch, in under 45 minutes. This is no BS! Dave enlists his buddy, Chris Ying, to help. The guys have nothing prepped, no plan, and no recipes. Dave’s gonna tackle the crust. Chris is gonna make the filling. The timer starts, and they’re off. WILL THEY MAKE IT HAPPEN?

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be made with all kinds of seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinates it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch; London Broil with Sundried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorites, Corn and Walnut Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about fresh seafood in this episode with three of Lidia's most requested fish recipes: Clam Bruschetta features crusty Italian bread, still warm from the grill with clam sauce; Halibut Baked with Mushrooms in a Lemon and White Wine Sauce is a great weeknight meal as is Grouper with Potatoes and Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Are you always in a rush to prepare something quick yet delicious for dinnertime? Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas, all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or a quick dinner. They include: Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms; Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives; Tuna with Mimosa Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion Tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer. Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filled Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring Lidia's family to the table. In this episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini, a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that will work in any kitchen. The menu includes: Carrot and Apple Salad; Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble - a dessert that can be made with almost any seasonal fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joining her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes - from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, and her Mafalde Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on a dish attributed to Michelangelo. Lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Dan + Shay. Dan + Shay met at a house party in Nashville in December 2012 and started writing songs together not long after — an unlikely pairing, given Dan came from an emo band background and Shay had been a solo artist on T-Pain's label. Since then, the duo has become one of the most decorated acts in country music history: three consecutive Grammy Awards for Best Country Duo/Group Performance for "Tequila," "Speechless," and "10,000 Hours" with Justin Bieber, alongside dozens of ACM, CMA, and Billboard Music Award wins. Their crossover success has made them global streaming juggernauts, and in 2024 they became the first-ever coaching duo in the history of NBC's The Voice. Sitting down with Joel, Dan + Shay open up about the highs of over a decade together — the awards, the arenas, the recognition — but also the harder work underneath it: learning to communicate honestly, untangling their self-worth from their results, and figuring out what it actually means to build a lasting partnership, both as a band and as best friends.

programme.title: Horror-Trip nach St. Barth!
programme.desc: Auch in Florida ist das Wetter schließlich manchmal schlecht – und so etwas kommt bei den Geissens gar nicht in die Tüte! Daher verlassen Carmen und Robert Miami in Richtung Karibik. (S6 E05)

programme.title: Romantik in der Karibik: Carmen Geiss schwebt auf
programme.desc: Die Geissens finden in der Karibik eine einsame Insel. Carmen Geiss überlegt kurzerhand, einfach mit der Yacht abzuhauen... Aber dann kommt alles anders - denn Robert hat eine Überraschung für sie! Carmen schwebt sofort auf Wolke 7. (S6 E06)

programme.title: Chaos pur: Reinhold Geiss bringt alle auf die Palme!
programme.desc: Robert und sein Vater Reinhold Geiss waren mit den Kindern "angeln". Leider ohne Erfolg. Die schnelle Lösung: ein Fisch vom Fischmarkt. Doch Carmen Geiss kann man nicht so leicht täuschen... (S6 E08)

programme.title: Auf den Spuren von Jennifer Lopez und Enrique
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich heute mit einem Kapitän, der ihnen das Gebiet rund um Miami zeigt. Doch Carmen Geiss' Stimmung ist direkt zu Beginn schon auf dem Tiefpunkt. Zum Glück ist für Ablenkung gesorgt: Ist das etwa die Villa von Jennifer Lopez? (S6 E09)

programme.title: Auf Wolke 7: Robert Geiss übertrifft sich selbst!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss verbringt die Weihnachtszeit in New York! Zuerst steht natürlich Shoppen bei Macy's auf dem Programm. Im Anschluss hat Robert Geiss noch etwas ganz Besonderes organisiert: einen Helikopterflug über die Lichter der Stadt. (S6 E10)

programme.title: Absolut wild: Reinhold Geiss riskiert sein Leben!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet den Everglades-Nationalpark in Florida. Doch dort wimmelt es nur so von wilden Alligatoren! Die möchten natürlich auch gefüttert werden! (S6 E11)

programme.title: WOW! Carmen Geiss lässt heiße Poolbilder machen...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss hat eine ganz besondere Überraschung geplant! Und dafür macht sie sich ausnahmsweise sogar die Haare nass! Unsere Lieblingsmillionärin möchte heiße Pool-Bilder für ihren Göttergatten Robert Geiss schießen lassen. (S6 E12)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens besuchen den Freizeitpark WonderWorks in Orlando. Erst testen sie einen Hurrikan-Simulator, dann geht es zum Indoor-Sky-Diving. Während die Kinder vorlegen, wagt Carmen den Sprung in den Windkanal. (S6 E14)

programme.title: Scharfes Fotoshooting: Carmen Geiss posiert mit
programme.desc: Heute steht das große Roberto-Geissini-Shooting an - und Robert Geiss hat diesmal richtig dick aufgetragen: bunte Harleys, heiße Models und eine brandneue Kollektion. (S6 E15)

programme.title: Inflagranti erwischt?!
programme.desc: Das gibt Ärger. Die Kinder und Robert haben Carmen Geiss' Wagen "verschönert". Noch bevor Robert Geiss die Situation retten kann, kommt sie plötzlich um die Ecke. Zum Glück hat sie kaum Zeit, sauer zu werden - denn es geht direkt ins Tonstudio. (S6 E16)

programme.title: Mega-Fail beim Poker Run in Miami!
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss wurden zum Speedboot-Event Poker Run in Miami eingeladen. Die Mission: Mit ihrer Donzi von Spot zu Spot fahren, an jeder Station eine Spielkarte sammeln und am Ende mit dem besten Pokerblatt gewinnen. (S6 E17)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens starten eine abenteuerliche Fahrt mit der Donzi. Damit alles gut geht, haben sie einen erfahrenen Kapitän mit an Bord, denn überall lauern Sandbänke. Und dann passiert das Unvermeidbare: Robert und Carmen Geiss sitzen plötzlich fest! (S6 E18)

programme.title: Horror im Keller: Carmen Geiss ist plötzlich
programme.desc: Robert Geiss macht ordentlich Dampf und schickt Carmen Geiss in den Keller, um die Koffer zu holen. Überall warten Klamottenberge darauf, verstaut zu werden. Aber wo bleibt Carmen? (S6 E19)

programme.title: Nichts geht mehr! Totalschaden bei Geissens'
programme.desc: Nach der Rückkehr aus Miami ist es in Monaco eisig kalt und das totale Chaos bricht aus! In der Tiefgarage steht sie kurz vorm Nervenzusammenbruch - kein einziges der heißgeliebten Luxusautos will anspringen! Nur der Maserati läuft… (S6 E20)

programme.title: Hat Robert Geiss heimlich eine Yacht gekauft?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss fliegt mit dem Helikopter von St. Tropez nach Monaco – und weiter nach Alicante. Dort wartet schon Robert Geiss' neues Projekt: ein riesiges Luxusboot. Doch auf der Yacht wird geschraubt, gehämmert und Möbel werden verschoben. (S6 E21)

programme.title: Couch über Bord: Carmen Geiss flippt aus!
programme.desc: Eigentlich wollten Carmen und Robert Geiss in Alicante die Renovierungsfortschritte auf ihrer neuen Yacht inspizieren. Doch plötzlich treibt Carmens Couch einfach im Hafen! Während Robert das Ganze gelassen sieht, ist Carmen kurz vorm Explodieren. (S7 E01)

programme.title: Das Neue Zuhause der Geissens
programme.desc: Carmen überbringt den Töchtern die Nachricht, dass sie sich ein neues Apartment gekauft haben. Bei der Begehung sind sie noch etwas voreingenommen, doch als sie erfahren, dass sie an den gesamten Umbauarbeiten teilhaben dürfen, sind sie überzeugt. (S19 E03)

programme.title: Die Tattoo-Intrige
programme.desc: Nach einem kurzen Abstecher zum Harley Davidson Store seilen sich die Frauen der Familie von Robert ab – unter dem Vorwand einer Shoppingtour. Was er noch nicht ahnt ist, dass sie sich ein gemeinsames Mutter-Tochter-Tattoo stechen lassen. (S19 E06)

programme.title: Carmen, die Kampfmaschine
programme.desc: Die Schwestern bekommen eine private Judostunde, um ihre Fähigkeiten im Bereich der Selbstverteidigung auszubauen. Doch womit wohl keiner gerechnet hat: Carmen ein absoluter Vollprofi im Kampfsport! (S19 E10)

programme.title: Trüffeljagd in Kroatien
programme.desc: In Kroatien steht bei den Geissens ein extravagantes Dinner mit Freunden an. Dafür hat sich Robert einen ganz besonderen Plan überlegt: Er möchte den Trüffel für das Essen selber sammeln! Ob die Trüffeljagd wohl erfolgreich sein wird? (S19 E12)

programme.title: Nur mit Gummi
programme.desc: In Kroatien vertreibt sich Familie Geiss die Zeit mit Wassersport. Doch es kommt zum Drama zwischen den Schwestern als Shania den Neoprenanzug von Davina anzieht... (S19 E13)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens sind auf den Pfaden von Winnetou unterwegs und entdecken plötzlich eine ganz unglamouröse Seite an sich.. Werden wir Carmen ab jetzt eher auf dem Bauernhof erleben? (S19 E14)

programme.title: Shopping-Wettrennen
programme.desc: Auf Sardinien veranstalten die Geissens ein Shopping-Wettrennen. Während Robert mit Shania vorlegt, kommen Carmen und Davina nicht so gut voran. Carmen ist total genervt davon und dann kauft Davina auch noch heimlich sündhaft teure Ohrringe... (S19 E18)

programme.title: Drink doch eene met Robert!
programme.desc: Robert hat das Shopping-Fieber gepackt – doch er hat die Qual der Wahl: Sneaker als Kapitalanlage nutzen oder doch lieber selbst tragen? Die Indigo Star sticht schließlich in See, auf nach Elba! (S19 E19)

programme.title: Shania und Davina: Pleite!
programme.desc: Robert hat beim Rundgang durchs neue Apartment nur Blödsinn im Kopf und treibt Carmen damit zur Weißglut. Davina und Shania streiten solange bis Robert zur disziplinarischen Maßnahme greift und die Kreditkarten sperren lassen will... (S19 E22)

programme.title: ​Kauft Robert Geiss eine 36 Millionen-Villa in
programme.desc: Nach längerer Zeit sind die Geissens mal wieder in Dubai und da steht natürlich einiges auf dem Programm. Unter anderem besichtigt die Familie eine luxuriöse Villa im Wert von ca. 36 Millionen Euro. Ob Robert da wohl zuschlagen wird? (S19 E23)
